name: vegeta
description: HTTP load testing tool and library written in Go - versatile and scriptable

vegeta.description: Versatile HTTP load testing tool with attack/report modes - supports custom headers, bodies, and detailed metrics reporting
vegeta.usage: echo 'GET http://localhost:8080' | vegeta attack -rate=100 -duration=30s | vegeta report\nvegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=50 -duration=10s | vegeta plot > plot.html
